blocks.text: Abbotsford West homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Abbotsford West, September 2026. Detached houses: 138 listed at month end and 12 sold in September, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 210 listed at month end and 16 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 55 over 4 months against an average of 139.8 listed, about 10.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 20 sold. condos and townhomes sold 86 over 4 months against an average of 215.0 listed, about 10.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 26 sold.
